subject: Evidence request: CI gate provenance, PR audit trail, and secrets rotation
messages:
From: VeriSecure Audit <verisec-audits@thirdpartyaudit.com>
To: rishi_malhotra
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CI gate provenance + secrets rotation artifacts for SIG

Rishi —

As part of the SIG assessment for FinBank (scope: inference API, tenant isolation), we need a short bundle demonstrating your secure SDLC controls. Please provide the following artifacts by EOD 2027-05-15:  

1) CI gate provenance for the api-service microservice (job IDs, timestamps, and the artifact hashes used to produce the build).
2) PR audit/log export showing reviewer approvals, timestamps, and merge actor for the last 6 months (or since 2026-11-01 if shorter).
3) Evidence of automated secret rotation for the KMS-backed service accounts (rotation schedule + rotation run logs).
4) Change management record linking the merge to an approved change ticket (ticket id and approval trail).

If you can provide a single downloadable bundle (or Drive link) that contains the logs and a short README with mapping between item # and file name, that will speed review. If any items are restricted, indicate how an assessor can get time-limited access.

Thanks,
Lena Park
Senior Assessor, VeriSecure
verisec-audits@thirdpartyaudit.com

--
VeriSecure is performing assessments on behalf of FinBank.
From: rishi_malhotra
To: marissa_cole, stephanie_nguyen, vanessa_ortiz, aditya_rao
Cc: VeriSecure Audit <verisec-audits@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: CI gate provenance + secrets rotation artifacts for SIG

Team —

Forwarding assessment ask from VeriSecure (FinBank scope). Timeline: EOD 2027-05-15. I want a single package we can hand to the assessor plus an internal mapping doc for auditability. Action items:  

- Stephanie: export PR provenance for api-service and include the reviewer/approver email, epoch timestamps, and merge commit hash. Put CSV in the drive folder and attach the PR IDs. (INF-4321 owns the ticket).
- Marissa: pull CI gate run logs for the last successful build used in the FinBank deployment (we already have job ids in CI). Include the job ID, runner, artifact SHA256, and any gating checks that failed/passed. Attach logs as plaintext.
- Vanessa: export KMS rotation records for the service accounts used by api-service and provide the rotation timestamps and key versions (anonymize the key material in the report). Also include the change approval trail that links the merge to a change ticket (who approved and when).
- Aditya: I'll need a short statement (1 paragraph) confirming the controls and that the files are redacted where applicable for production secrets.

I created JIRA INF-4321 and a Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finbank/sdlc-evidence-2027-05. Put artifacts there with filenames prefixed by your initials. Use the attachment naming convention in the ticket. If anything cannot be shared, explain why and propose an alternative (time-limited console session, auditor VPN, or masked logs).

I'll assemble and send the package to VeriSecure when we have everything.

-Rishi
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen
To: rishi_malhotra, marissa_cole, vanessa_ortiz
Cc: VeriSecure Audit <verisec-audits@thirdpartyaudit.com>, aditya_rao
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: CI gate provenance + secrets rotation artifacts for SIG

Rishi —

Attached: pr-provenance-export-20270512.csv (see Drive folder). Summary:  

- Export covers PRs merged into main for api-service between 2026-11-01 and 2027-05-12. Fields included: pr_id, branch, author, reviewer_list, approval_timestamps (ISO), merge_actor, merge_commit, ci_job_id, artifact_sha256.
- Sampling notes: one PR (PR#3421) was merged via admin override; I flagged it in the CSV and included the justification link (INF-2107) in the comments column.
- I also included a short provenance README (provenance-readme.md) that maps CSV columns to the CI job IDs you'll see in the logs.

Attachment stubs in Drive: pr-provenance-export-20270512.csv, provenance-readme.md

Let me know if you want the raw GitHub audit log (it contains IPs) or if sanitized CSV is sufficient for the assessor.

- Stephanie
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra
To: VeriSecure Audit <verisec-audits@thirdpartyaudit.com>, FinBank SOC2 Team <soc2@finbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole, stephanie_nguyen, vanessa_ortiz, aditya_rao
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence package delivered: CI gate logs, PR provenance, KMS rotation report

Lena / FinBank team —

Per your request, attached is the evidence bundle for api-service in support of the SIG assessment. Files (Drive, view-only link provided above):  

- ci-gate-logs-20270510.txt — CI run outputs for the build used in the FinBank deployment (job IDs: 10234, 10236). Contains step-by-step gate checks and artifact SHA256 (redacted secrets).
- pr-provenance-export-20270512.csv — PR-level audit with reviewer approvals and merge commit hashes (sanitized where necessary).
- kms-rotation-report-20270430.pdf — KMS rotation schedule and last rotation run logs (key versions shown; key material removed).
- change-approval-audittrail-INF-4321.json — Change ticket export showing approvers and timestamps for the merge that created the deployed artifact.

Notes:  
- We redacted IP addresses and principal ARNs from the GitHub audit export; the provenance CSV contains the reviewer emails and ISO timestamps. If the assessor needs full audit logs for forensic purposes we can provide a time-limited console view; request a signed NDA and we'll open access for a 72-hour window.
- The CI job IDs map to artifacts stored in our immutable artifact store. If you require checksums beyond SHA256 present in the logs, let us know and we'll share signed attestations from the build server.

Related ticket: JIRA INF-4321 (change management) — link in the Drive README.

Attachments included for reviewer convenience; if anything is missing ping me and I'll escalate.

Regards,

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: ci-gate-logs-20270510.txt; pr-provenance-export-20270512.csv; kms-rotation-report-20270430.pdf; change-approval-audittrail-INF-4321.json
